description: Files that are DELIBERATELY not valid YAML. They exist so the canonical policy parser can be proven to reject malformed input, so they cannot also satisfy the repository-wide YAML sanity check. This registry is the ONLY exemption from that check, and the exemption is two-way: an unregistered file that fails to parse is an error, and a registered file that parses cleanly is also an error. Enforced by scripts/audits/yaml-corpus-audit.sh and tested by tests/prod/115-invalid-yaml-corpus.sh. Note that MOST of the rejected corpus is NOT listed here: valid YAML that the Sentinel contract rejects (duplicate keys, anchors, block scalars, multi-document) must still satisfy repository YAML sanity.
